title: Adding 1 to 100 in seconds
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 170" role="img" aria-label="Pairing the first and last numbers of 1 to 100" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><text x="40" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">1</text><text x="80" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">2</text><text x="120" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">3</text><text x="160" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">…</text><text x="205" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">99</text><text x="255" y="70" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">100</text><path d="M40,80 Q147,140 255,80" class="u" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M80,80 Q142,118 205,80" class="u" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="150" y="150" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">each pair = 101</text></svg>
back: The story goes that young Gauss paired 1 + 100, 2 + 99, …: 50 pairs of 101 make 5050. That pairing is the sum formula.

title: What an AP looks like
back: Every term is the one before plus the same $d$, so the bars rise by equal steps (or fall, if $d$ is negative).

title: nth term
back: Ten fence posts, nine gaps: $(n-1)$ steps of $d$.

title: Sum of n terms, knowing d
back: The $\dfrac n2$ multiplies the whole bracket.

title: Sum of n terms, knowing the last term
back: Number of terms × average of the first and the last.

title: A term from two sums
back: If $S_n$ is given as a formula: $a=S_1$ and $a_2=S_2-S_1$.

title: 1 + 2 + … + n
back: First 100 natural numbers: 5050. First $n$ odd numbers: $n^2$.

title: Three numbers in AP
back: Their sum is $3a$, so the middle number comes out at once.

title: Are a, b, c in AP?
back: Twice the middle term equals the sum of the other two. Used to find $k$.

title: Term or sum?
back: 'In the 10th week' is a term. 'In 10 weeks' is a sum.
